description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Glen Elendra Archmage
When Glen Elendra Archmage dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Glen Elendra Archmage enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Glen Elendra Archmage
Repeat.
